title: CORTICAL DYSPLASIA, COMPLEX, WITH OTHER BRAIN MALFORMATIONS 17

intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that complex cortical dysplasia with other brain malformations-17 (CDCBM17) is caused by homozygous mutation in the DMRTA2 gene (614804) on chromosome 1p32.3.

checks.claim: Complex cortical dysplasia with other brain malformations-17 (CDCBM17) is caused by homozygous mutation in the DMRTA2 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: Autozygosity mapping and exome sequencing identified a homozygous novel single base pair deletion, c.1197delT in DMRTA2
checks.explanation: Paper attributes the cortical malformation to a homozygous DMRTA2 variant; CDCBM17 is the OMIM label for this disorder.

checks.claim: The DMRTA2 gene is located on chromosome 1p32.3.
checks.evidence_quote: DMRTA2 encodes doublesex and mab-3-related transcription factor a2
checks.explanation: Chromosomal location is standard nomenclature not stated in the abstract, accepted per instructions.

paragraphs.text: Complex cortical dysplasia with other brain malformations-17 (CDCBM17) is an autosomal recessive disorder that begins before birth. It is characterized by a severe neurodevelopmental disorder with fronto-parietal pachygyria, agenesis of the corpus callosum, and progressive severe microcephaly (Urquhart et al., 2016).

checks.evidence_quote: A consanguineous family was ascertained with three siblings affected
checks.explanation: The abstract does not state autosomal recessive inheritance. It is implied by the consanguineous family and the homozygous variant.

paragraphs.text: Urquhart et al. (2016) studied 3 sibs from a consanguineous family with CDCBM17. The sibs had a severe neurodevelopmental disorder that began before birth, with fronto-parietal pachygyria, agenesis of the corpus callosum, and progressive severe microcephaly. Autozygosity mapping and exome sequencing identified a homozygous 1-bp deletion (c.1197delT) in the DMRTA2 gene in these sibs. The deletion was predicted to result in a frameshift, pro400-to-leu (P400Lfs*33).
